concepts.def: UK government plate-format guide showing recommended proportions of food groups.
Aim for 5+ portions a day; rich in vitamins, minerals and fibre.
Bread, rice, potatoes, pasta; ~38% of daily intake; choose wholegrain when possible.
Beans, pulses, fish, eggs, meat; aim for 2 portions of fish per week (1 oily).
Milk, cheese, yoghurt or fortified plant drinks; supply calcium and protein.
Eat sparingly; high in calories and linked to obesity and tooth decay.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Food Science — a core area of GCSE Food Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Food Science brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Science.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
